content:
anna_sales: AstroHealth sent an RFI this morning. Key asks: 4-week dedicated POC, embeddings + chat capability matrix, explicit KMS/HSM support details, and proof points for SOC2/FedRAMP posture. I uploaded their RFI PDF as astro_rfi_2024.pdf. Need to assemble draft responses and a pricing stub.
jordan_se: I can do the tech capability copy. Quick Q for perf team: do we want to propose a 2-node A10 baseline or a 4x smaller GPU pool for the POC? Their note mentions 200 QPS peak bursts.
maria_ps: I recommend starting with 2x A10 baseline and we instrument load tests. I'll own perf. Need their sample corpus (PHI-scrubbed) or we send a synthetic generator. Also, what's the target p99 they expect? They wrote "low latency" but no numbers.
anna_sales: I'll ask them for target SLOs and a sanitized sample. For pricing, they asked for a provisional POC quote and an option to convert to Reserved. Can we give a ballpark monthly anchor?
jordan_se: Ballpark (provisional): 2x A10 baseline for POC ~ $45k for 4 weeks (includes reserved baseline + managed ops). Conversion to Reserved would be MSRP discounting applied. Mark it "subject to finance/legal". I'll draft the language.
sam_security: Security note: We support KMS in Hosted with tenant key separation; Private supports KMS/HSM via our partner integrations (YubiHSM/CloudHSM) depending on customer environment. We need to call out: HSM-backed key support available on Private deployments only, and requires contract addendum. I'll draft a short appendix.
legal_lee: Heads up: any HSM claims must be qualified. Also, for FedRAMP/FISMA asks, we can provide our controls mapping but we are not FedRAMP authorized. Provide a migration/partner plan and avoid implying certification.
maria_ps: Draft capability matrix I put in the thread. Paste below to iterate:

```
Feature,Hosted API,Dedicated Pools,Private (VPC/On-prem)
Text generation,Yes,Yes,Yes
Embeddings,Yes,Yes,Yes
Private KMS,No,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Optional add-on,Partner integration req'd
FedRAMP posture,Controls documented,Controls documented,By request + plan
SLA,Standard,Enhanced,Enterprise (negotiable)
Auto-fallback,Region spill,Policy-driven spill,Policy-driven w/ customer notice
```

anna_sales: Good. They specifically want an example fallback policy: what exactly happens when Dedicated nodes reach capacity and requests queue. Can we include a one-paragraph flow?
jordan_se: Sure. Suggest wording: "Fallback policy example: primary Dedicated pool handles requests; upon sustained queueing ( > 5s median queue time or >85% node utilization for 2min) traffic is routed to: 1) reserved burst nodes, 2) secondary dedicated pool in another region if cross-region allowed, 3) gracefully degrade to a smaller model variant with notification headers and rate-limited responses. Admins can configure circuit-break thresholds and notification hooks in the Console." Happy to tweak.
sam_security: Also include a short note on logging/data residency: all customer payloads for Dedicated/Private are isolated; Hosted has tenant separation but review their data residency needs. For PHI, we need a BAA in place.
anna_sales: Action items:
1) I'll request sample/scrubbed corpus and target SLOs from AstroHealth.
2) @maria_ps to finalize capability matrix and perf plan.
3) @jordan_se to write the fallback paragraph and provisional pricing blurb.
4) @sam_security + @legal_lee to draft KMS/HSM appendix and compliance caveats.
5) I'll bundle and send draft to AstroHealth tomorrow COB, marking finance/legal items provisional.

maria_ps: I'll upload the perf plan and an updated matrix by 11am PT tomorrow.

jordan_se: I'll drop a pricing stub and fallback paragraph by 2pm.

sam_security: I'll prep the security appendix and attach the security questionnaire link.

doc-bot: Uploaded: astro_rfi_response_draft.pdf -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/1765503210/astro_rfi_response_draft.pdf

anna_sales: Thanks team. If anything blocks signoff, ping me here and I'll escalate.
